name: Ardax's Puzzle Box
disable: DC 19 Thievery check (trained), DC 18 Thievery check, and DC 18 Perception check simultaneously by at least 3 characters; one of these checks can be replaced by a Strike against AC 19, and one can be replaced by targeting the box with a spell that has the electricity trait and deals at least 1 damage (this ignores the box's Hardness).

items.name: Shocking Failure
items.text:
Trigger A creature fails one of the disable checks

---
Effect An electric jolt shocks all creatures who were attempting to open the box. This deals 2d8+5 nonlethal electricity damage, and each creature must attempt a DC 21 basic Reflex save save.

text: A chest-sized puzzle box is covered in intricate designs, with no immediately obvious way to open it.
